description: A non-modal floating panel anchored to a trigger element. Built on Radix UI Popover which provides role="dialog" and manages focus. Unlike Dialog, focus is not trapped by default — users can Tab out of the popover.

keyboard.action: Closes the popover and returns focus to the trigger
Moves focus through focusable elements; may move focus out of the popover
Moves focus backwards; may move focus out of the popover

focus.notes: Focus moves to the popover content when it opens. On close, focus returns to the trigger element. Focus is not trapped — Tab can move focus outside the popover, which will close it.

announcements: Popover content is announced when focus moves into it
The trigger is associated with the popover via aria-haspopup and aria-expanded
screenReader.notes: Because the popover is non-modal, screen readers can still access content behind the popover. Use aria-label or aria-labelledby on the popover content to provide context.

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA — popover uses popover-foreground on popover background
contrast.ui: Meets WCAG AA (>3:1 for borders and focus rings)

consumerResponsibilities: Ensure the trigger clearly indicates it opens a popover
Provide an aria-label or aria-labelledby on the popover content for context
Consider whether focus trapping is needed for complex popover content
Avoid placing critical actions inside popovers that users might miss
